label: Wärmepumpe
baustein_notes: Greenfield prefix Earnie_Waermepumpe_* (+ Earnie_Waermespeicher_* temps). HK type thermal_annual (id wp_heating). Prefer EFM Load Bezeichnung for flex.wp_heating.sens_power_act. T_eq/T_low: SM supplies volume-weighted T_eq; T_low = raw bottom sensor. Level 3 feedback (HeatControl P1) is optional and read-only; Soll + Toleranz together switch Live to the controller's store band.

recommended_markers.notes: Heatpump active power kW. entity-scoped VO path flex.{hk_id}.sens_power_act.
SG-Ready / Freigabe 0/1. VI Check key flex.{hk_id}.Earnie_Waermepumpe_Freigabe.
Energy-equivalent store T_eq (°C). VO path sens_temperature_heat_storage.
Lowest immersion sensor T_low (°C); Live WP-on hint when below band floor.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Top store sensor (°C).
Level 3 feedback, optional. Controller's present store setpoint (°C). Together with the tolerance: Live plans with the controller's band.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Band below the setpoint without heat request (K).
Level 3 feedback, optional. Highest store temperature the controller allows (°C).
Level 3 feedback, optional. 0 off, 1 space heating, 2 hot water, 3 defrost, 4 locked, 5 cooling, 6 fault (request of the controller).
Level 3 feedback, optional. SG-Ready state 1-4 the controller applies.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Thermal power kW (heat meter).
Level 3 feedback, optional. Source temperature (brine, ground water) °C.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Separate hot-water tank °C, if present.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Hot-water comfort minimum °C.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Reference room or mean of the participating rooms °C.
Level 3 feedback, optional. Effective room setpoint °C.
Optional heating rod release 0/1 (Kennung {hk_id}_heating_rod). Over-temperature and outage protection stay in the smart home.
Optional heating rod power kW, or sens_consumer_active as run state; Live plans the rod only with one of them.
